recommendation: Keep the empty external-repo audit commit as-is. Any future edits to the individual gender identity extension context or its search parameter should be made in HL7/fhir-extensions, not by reintroducing the extension definition into core.
issue_request: FHIR-39195 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-core PA change request for R5 asking that the gender identity extension allow practitioner work contexts. Its resolution was to add PractitionerRole as an allowed context for the individual-genderIdentity extension.
initial_application: No current FHIR core commit mentions FHIR-39195. Core history shows the former individual-genderIdentity StructureDefinition was removed from the core checkout by dd468d4f17 when R5 extension definitions moved out of core. The applying commit is in HL7/fhir-extensions: 3117822c513484ba5a1ee7e38dcecd49e33856e5 added the PractitionerRole context to StructureDefinition-individual-genderIdentity.xml.
additional_context: Current core source retains extensibility machinery, OID metadata, and narrative/example references to the external extension location, but no in-build individual-genderIdentity StructureDefinition source. Current Extension Pack source includes PractitionerRole in the extension context list. Later same-family issue FHIR-46412 added a genderIdentity search parameter in the Extensions IG with PractitionerRole as a base, reinforcing that this extension family is maintained there. PA Confluence minutes corroborate the Jira vote context, and direct Zulip searches found no conflicting discussion.
reconciliation: No core source files were changed. The reconciliation published an empty audit commit on the combined FHIR core branch to record that the requested change belongs to, and is already satisfied in, the FHIR Extension Pack checkout.

related_jiras.note: Later Applied core issue created the Extensions IG genderIdentity search parameter for the same individual-genderIdentity extension and includes PractitionerRole as a base; it was used as background evidence, not decided in this run.
